testcase.name: Scenario: Select staged commands with Ctrl+A: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-customization-source/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:1577:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Select staged commands with Ctrl+A ✔> Given the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a part is active in the MCAD Software with the full Tools ribbon visible ✔ And ribbon customization shows an initially empty Part Tools target ✔ And 2D Sketches and 3D Annotations are staged on Part Tools in that order ✔ And both commands have Large and Text unchecked ✔ When the user clicks the 2D Sketches name in the staged target list ✔ And the user presses Ctrl+A while the target list has focus ✔ Then both staged command rows are highlighted ✔ And both commands still have Large and Text unchecked ✔ And Part Tools remains marked as having pending changes ✔ When the user cancels ribbon customization ✔ Then the customization dialog closes
